gates.summary: Version synchronization, real Quick/Best inference, package data, native architecture, backend provenance, checksums, and distinct archive digests are enforced by CI.
gates.next_action: Keep these checks required for every release.

gates.summary: Developer ID signing, notarization, stapling, and Gatekeeper verification are implemented but have no production credentials.
gates.next_action: Provide the documented Apple Developer credentials, then verify the downloaded artifact on a separate Mac.

gates.summary: Windows executables are not Authenticode signed.
gates.next_action: Choose a certificate provider and secret-handling method before adding the signing stage.

gates.summary: The cross-built macOS artifacts retain PyTorch 2.2.2 security debt.
gates.next_action: Build Apple Silicon natively with maintained PyTorch and decide whether a supportable Intel distribution remains viable.

gates.summary: CI packaging does not prove operation on every advertised GPU, driver, and CPU combination.
gates.next_action: Complete and retain acceptance records for macOS ARM/Intel, Windows NVIDIA/DirectML/CPU, and Linux CUDA/ROCm/XPU/CPU.

gates.summary: Generated fixtures cover edge paths, but representative user media and resource-pressure behavior still require physical testing.
gates.next_action: Test large images, transparency, DNG, cancellation, low disk, low memory, and thermals using the acceptance record template.

gates.summary: The optional HAT-S Face checkpoint is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and cannot be treated as commercially licensed.
gates.next_action: Decide whether to retain it as a clearly noncommercial option, replace it, or exclude it from distributed recommendations.

gates.summary: The Best and anime release pages use the nonstandard license string CC-BY-0.4.
gates.next_action: Obtain written clarification from the checkpoint publisher before public or commercial claims.

gates.summary: The private repository and restricted issue intake are not accessible to general beta users.
gates.next_action: Choose a public download location and low-friction feedback route, then test both while signed out.

gates.summary: Video, SeedVR2, de-flicker, codecs, and multi-video behavior remain experimental.
gates.next_action: Keep all video surfaces labeled Labs until queue, codec, resource, and physical-device coverage is complete.
